reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper from #shared/schedules, which already encodes the missing/number/range rule used by forecast, schedule-template and schedules app.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the new field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, the layer that maps internal entities to API shapes, with the handler type updated accordingly.

scope.why: Touches only the model mapping, handler type, test expectation and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; the separate APIScheduleListEntity type is reasonable since fromExternal/create still take APIScheduleEntity, though it adds a second type for a one-field difference.
